summary: Comprehensive testing of My Orders feature (iteration 64). All backend API tests and frontend UI tests pass. The GET /api/print/my-orders endpoint works correctly with auth, the MyOrders page renders all required UI elements, and all states (loading skeleton, empty state, error state, orders list) work correctly.

frontend_features.my_orders_route: PASS - /my-orders accessible with ProtectedRoute, redirects to /auth if not logged in
frontend_features.loading_skeleton: PASS - data-testid='orders-loading' shows 3 animated skeleton cards during fetch, disappears after load
frontend_features.orders_list: PASS - data-testid='orders-list' renders when orders present
frontend_features.order_card_fields: PASS - Order card shows: book cover img (Friendship Island), title, ref (AZ-TEST-ORDER1), date (17 Mar 2026), price (£19.98), status badge (Shipped)
frontend_features.status_badge: PASS - Blue 'Shipped' badge with truck icon and pulsing dot for shipped orders
frontend_features.tracking_link: PASS - Tracking row visible for shipped orders: ROYALMAIL · Tracking JD014600004947503980, 'Track' link opens https://www.royalmail.com/track-your-item#/tracking-results/... in new tab (_blank)
frontend_features.status_summary_chips: PASS - '1 Shipped' summary chip shown in page header
frontend_features.navbar_dropdown_my_orders: PASS - data-testid='menu-my-orders' present in user profile dropdown with FiPackage icon
frontend_features.navbar_click_navigation: PASS - Clicking 'My Orders' in dropdown navigates to /my-orders
frontend_features.empty_state: PASS - data-testid='orders-empty-state' shows 'No print orders yet' with 'Browse My Books' CTA button (data-testid='orders-cta-button') navigating to /dashboard
frontend_features.error_state: PASS - data-testid='orders-error-state' shows 'Couldn't load orders' with Retry button (data-testid='orders-retry-button') on API failure
frontend_features.book_cover_thumbnail: PASS - Book cover thumbnail renders correctly (Friendship Island beach scene with animated characters)

context_for_next_testing_agent: My Orders feature is complete and fully working. Backend: GET /api/print/my-orders returns 401 without auth, 200 with valid JWT (azories-token in localStorage). Response: {orders: [...], total: N}. Each order has display_status (preparing/shipped/delivered/cancelled), price_display (£X.XX), book_cover_url. Tracking array for shipped orders contains {tracking_number, carrier} objects. Frontend: /my-orders route is ProtectedRoute-wrapped. All states (loading skeleton x3, empty state, error state, order list) have data-testid attributes. Navbar user dropdown has data-testid='menu-my-orders'. The welcome onboarding modal appears on first load per session and can interfere with dropdown testing - navigate directly to /my-orders to bypass it.
